'''Jurgan Kalta's power suit''' was a custom [[Power armor/Legends|powersuit]] created for the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], [[Jurgan Kalta]], that made him near-invulnerable in battle. The [[Armor/Legends|armor]] provided a high level of protection to heat, cold, and sonic attacks, in addition to rendering the wearer immune to mind-altering attacks through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It was believed that [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] may have acquired this powersuit at the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]], during his search for the [[Star Map]]s.
